comments.author: @EarthsLastPlaces
comments.text: A drive-in volcano sitting right next to the Pitons is not something I had ever pictured in the Caribbean. Which of the two was more striking to see in person?

replies.author: @ImpossibleTravel38
replies.text: It’s hard to choose, but the dramatic volcanic spires of the Pitons are absolutely breathtaking to see in person! ❤️
